versions.changelog:
golang-swagger v1.1.0

- Added path restriction: skill now only applies to `*.go` files (`paths: [**/*.go]`).
- Expanded tool compatibility metadata; now lists support for Codex and more LSP/tools.
- Updated metadata and version numbers to reflect v1.1.0.
- Clarified compatibility, dependencies, and usage setup in the SKILL.md.
- Removed legacy skill-card.md file.

Initial release of golang-swagger documentation skill.

- Guides adding and maintaining OpenAPI/Swagger docs in Go projects using swaggo/swag.
- Covers setup, annotation conventions, CLI usage, and Swagger UI integration for popular Go web frameworks (gin, echo, fiber, chi, net/http).
- Documents security definitions (Bearer/JWT, OAuth2, API keys), struct tag usage (enums, example, swaggertype, swaggerignore), and typical mistakes.
- Includes concise reference examples for handler annotations and project configuration.
- Requires go and swag CLI; compatible with Claude Code and similar coding agents.
